review_items.title: 'Confirmed supply' proposed for Corrigan's 60% ferric allocation: count the allocated volume as confirmed receipts in days of cover and in the award?
review_items.detail: Corrigan's notice allocates 60% of contract volume from 12 October until further notice. The order lines show what has actually shipped since then; nothing confirms the allocation will hold or for how long. Accepting the proposal would make 'confirmed supply' mean 'what a supplier says it will allocate', so days of cover at the five plants under ten days (Fenmoor 6.2, Holloway Creek 7.4, Stanwick 8.1, Marston Reach 9.3, Quinton Lakes 9.6) would look better than the order lines support, and Corrigan's ferric bid would read as deliverable.

Create a state 'confirmed = allocated by the supplier'

story_group.story: Bramwell Environmental Group runs three businesses, Bramwell Water, Bramwell Hazardous Waste and Bramwell Energy, at 33 operating sites, and a group procurement function with three regional distribution centers. A site is keyed by site_code and belongs to one business; an item is keyed by material_code (CHM-FECL-40 for ferric chloride, SPR-RFB-HA90 for refractory brick) and carries a criticality: class A items stop a plant or breach a permit when they run out. Spend is the ordered value of purchase order lines by order date. A line ordered on a group contract carries the contract number; a line off contract carries the contract price of the material when a contract covers it, which is what makes it leakage. Stock is a nightly snapshot per site and material with on-hand, safety stock and average use; for treatment chemicals the safety stock is a minimum number of days of cover (14 at water plants, 10 at hazardous waste facilities, 7 at energy plants). Work orders reserve materials; a planned outage groups work orders and carries the margin lost per day. Sourcing events hold bids by lot with price and freight, and an award compares landed cost among qualified suppliers. A supplier's promise is the promised date on its confirmation; a letter or a mail about supply is a statement until an order line or a contract records it. Carrier tracking and the supplier risk ratings service are not connected, so shipment arrivals and supplier financial health are not in this graph.

Percentages in documents are on time in full computed at a date; they are not stored.

Outage dates in the scope match ops.outage_plan.
A date in a mail is a statement until the promised date on the line carries it.
The Procurement Committee awards events.
Dosing plans name the chemical by material number.
Stock is kept per material.
A person who writes about a supplier is not the supplier.
An allocation percentage is not a quantity on hand.
